title: USF Audit Event Schema
description: Draft JSON Schema for audit event definitions (audit events, security-sensitive audits, state-changing audits, accountability records). Each declares its kind (audit-event-kinds), actor, action, subject, timestamp semantics, and security-sensitivity / state-change classification, mapped to the interface/workflow/semantic contract it accompanies. Every mutating or privileged action MUST have a defined audit semantic; audit coverage MUST NOT be removed as an incidental refactor. Governs the ontology concept Audit Event. lifecycleState draft; not active. GOVERNANCE ENVELOPE: instances MUST carry id, title, description, authorityLevel, lifecycleState, ontologyConcepts, taxonomyRefs, vocabularyRefs, and aiGuidance (schema-authoring-standard section 9/11). Envelope fields kind (artefact-kinds) and version are deviated and intentionally not required: this artefact is not a top-level artefact-kind and instance versioning is deferred to instance-topology definition (recorded deviation per schema-authoring-standard section 9.3).

authorityLevel.$comment: authority-levels canonical value pinned to this schema's registry authorityRole.
